mechanism: Both agents are commonly used together for synergistic antibacterial activity (as in co-trimoxazole), but trimethoprim can inhibit renal tubular secretion of ampicillin, potentially increasing ampicillin levels and risk of adverse effects.
action: Monitor renal function and clinical response; this combination is often intentional (co-trimoxazole contains both), but adjust doses if renal impairment is present.
